end.parentNote: Pari practised explaining why drinking water should be covered and taken with a ladle, using dust, germs, and mosquitoes as examples. They also identified that clear-looking water may still contain germs or dissolved substances. They used “melt” when describing salt dissolving; practise saying “salt dissolves and spreads through the water” at home. Ask Pari to name two safe-storage rules while setting a covered water container.
